thought.text: Login page loads. Now I'll perform a full login test with the generated admin credentials.

reasoning_content: The login page has a CSRFToken, and I'll need to extract it. Let me try logging in as admin using the generated password. I need to check the form more carefully to get a handle on the required fields (Step, AccountType, Language).

action.command: cd /tmp && CSRF=$(grep -oE 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "CSRF=$CSRF" && STEP=$(grep -oE 'name="Step" value="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "STEP=$STEP" && ACC=$(grep -oE 'name="AccountType" value="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "ACC=$ACC" && LANG=$(grep -oE 'name="Language" value="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "LANG=$LANG" && curl -s -b qcookie.txt -c qcookie.txt -D - -o login-after.html -X POST http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=$CSRF" --data-urlencode "Step=$STEP" --data-urlencode "AccountType=$ACC" --data-urlencode "Language=$LANG" --data-urlencode "Login=admin" --data-urlencode "Password=LVRS3SUBEBF+SJQBDF_%4FYY" | head -15; echo '---'; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' login-after.html | head -2
